description:
1. Build reports & dashboards
* Gather and confirm requirements with business users before building.
* Build Power BI reports that follow team design and KPI standards.
* Write SQL (BigQuery) and DAX; build and improve data models.
* Check report numbers against source data before release.
* Update reports when source systems change.
2. Maintain reports
* Monitor daily refresh; fix or escalate failures quickly.
* Fix report errors and handle small change requests.
* Find the root cause of repeated issues and prevent them.
* Spot unusual data and alert the business users.
3. Support users
* Answer user questions and investigate reported issues.
* Write short guides and run walkthroughs for new reports.
* Help users find answers on their own, with fewer ad-hoc data requests.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor's degree in IT, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, Business or a related field.
* 1-3 years in BI, data analysis or reporting.
* Strong Power BI knowledge: data modeling, DAX, Power Query and report design.
* Good SQL skill: joins, CTEs, window functions.
* Good Excel skill.
* Careful with numbers; checks data before sharing.
* Clear communication with non-technical users, in Vietnamese and English.
